description:
## [2.0.0](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/compare/v1.32.1...v2.0.0) (2026-10-22)

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* Steam Link 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968 and 2.0.22/5002244 are
no longer supported, and the patches "Full-FOV foveal canvas (experimental)" and
"OpenXR CPU and GPU BOOST (2.0.21/2.0.22)" no longer exist.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Add cavecrew skill and morphe-patches skill documentation ([9784e94](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/9784e9443a80e998f4b1ac932f00992936cf8d7a))
* edited Steam Link identity patches to unify model handling ([a5a9d8c](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/a5a9d8cefc5d8935c9baa0a913750378e528e966))
* enhance Android compilation and runtime behavior for GXR spacewarp layer ([09dc946](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/09dc946ff41baaae7e0d76c8f02a48d1879cca16))

### ✨ New Features

* **foveal:** support 2.0.20/5001712 and 2.0.23/5002363 ([d426ee2](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/d426ee22c3ee192f98591900fcaa94e8d5ef1a32))
* implement context-safe resource management and ownership tracking for ASW sessions ([246b882](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/246b882300f1250f0a439ee83d1eea0ee0e9ad8e))
* retire half-rate synthesis mode and update related logic in VTS ([68048aa](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/68048aa2d20107f95d7676b08db364d6f254708d))
* retire Steam Link 5001812, 5001968 and 5002244 support ([6d19288](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/6d19288bcc91a223ca6277c98f7428fbde19c528))
* **spacewarp:** implement dormant fast path and carrier generation tracking ([68e9d1a](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/68e9d1adbec53b98f218c354505b93cf27ddd8c3))
* **steamlink:** make OpenXR BOOST experimental ([9b1d581](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/9b1d581f0a934c3ad3314da9ecfc84b3f2a0f4b3))
* **steamlink:** restore support for all five builds ([9a75e32](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/9a75e32297b43c70907703a2c37c7ac0520ca07d))
* update codecs support to version 7 with enhanced stability and crash fixes ([ba5c178](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/ba5c178ff463717208abc33bd1edea67841bb669))
* update codecs support to version 8 with stability improvements and crash fixes ([c9e0efa](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/c9e0efa88e7005d37665662bd1c770a09b01c22e))

patches.name: 5.1-channel audio bridge (4XVR)
patches.description: Switches 4XVR video playback to 5.1 surround sound on the headset speakers. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Audio bridge payload (4XVR)
patches.description: Adds the bundled sound engine that lets 4XVR play 5.1 surround sound on the headset speakers. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Frame-synced render dispatch (4XVR)
patches.description: Syncs scene changes and screen updates to the display's frame rhythm, keeping playback smooth. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR controller models (4XVR)
patches.description: Replaces the Quest 3 controller artwork and shapes with the Galaxy XR controller models. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR launch compatibility (4XVR)
patches.description: Installs the standard XR files 4XVR needs to start on Galaxy XR instead of closing right after opening. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR launcher icon (4XVR)
patches.description: Restores the proper 4XVR icon on the device's app launcher and in the patch manager. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Galaxy XR refresh profile (72 Hz, 4XVR)
patches.description: Runs 4XVR's picture at Galaxy XR's native 72 Hz rate instead of 60 Hz. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: HDR pipeline payload (4XVR)
patches.description: Adds the HDR video component and its open-source notices; built on libplacebo (LGPL-2.1-or-later). Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Meta platform decoupling (4XVR)
patches.description: Keeps the Meta store calls out of the way, so 4XVR starts instead of hanging on its splash screen. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Popup refresh on resume (4XVR)
patches.description: Re-checks the first-launch prompts after you return from system settings. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Premium unlock (4XVR, experimental)
patches.description: Unlocks premium playback without a store check on Galaxy XR, where the store cannot be reached. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Render dispatch payload (4XVR)
patches.description: Adds the scene-timing engine that keeps 4XVR visuals and screens in step with the frames. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Startup and UI continuity helper (4XVR)
patches.description: Keeps the startup greeting and on-screen notifications working when the app rebuilds its display. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Subtitle suite (4XVR)
patches.description: Moves subtitles around, enlarges the subtitle panel and loads your own subtitle font. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: Subtitle suite payload (4XVR)
patches.description: Adds the subtitle engine used by the 4XVR subtitle controls. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

patches.name: libplacebo HDR pipeline (4XVR)
patches.description: HDR videos play with their full colors and brightness. Builds: 4XVR 2.0.22/20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.

options.description: Presets gamma and saturation. Applies to both layers, or only the background when a VD-like center option is on.
Used with the Custom profile. Higher darkens dark tones. Range: 0.50 to 2.50.
Used with the Custom profile. Higher makes colors more intense. Range: 0.00 to 3.00.

A sharper center look (VD-style), keeping Valve's color correction and 8-bit output. Skips the profile above in the center; the center gamma below still applies. Turn off when Blue-noise dithering's center option is on.

Extra gamma for the center only. 1.00 = unchanged; higher darkens dark tones. Try 1.02 first for a slightly lighter center. The background keeps the profile above; this is a manual tweak, not a verified seam fix.

release_notes:
## [2.0.0](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/compare/v1.32.1...v2.0.0) (2026-10-22)

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* Steam Link 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968 and 2.0.22/5002244 are
no longer supported, and the patches "Full-FOV foveal canvas (experimental)" and
"OpenXR CPU and GPU BOOST (2.0.21/2.0.22)" no longer exist.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Add cavecrew skill and morphe-patches skill documentation ([9784e94](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/9784e9443a80e998f4b1ac932f00992936cf8d7a))
* edited Steam Link identity patches to unify model handling ([a5a9d8c](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/a5a9d8cefc5d8935c9baa0a913750378e528e966))
* enhance Android compilation and runtime behavior for GXR spacewarp layer ([09dc946](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/09dc946ff41baaae7e0d76c8f02a48d1879cca16))

### ✨ New Features

* **foveal:** support 2.0.20/5001712 and 2.0.23/5002363 ([d426ee2](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/d426ee22c3ee192f98591900fcaa94e8d5ef1a32))
* implement context-safe resource management and ownership tracking for ASW sessions ([246b882](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/246b882300f1250f0a439ee83d1eea0ee0e9ad8e))
* retire half-rate synthesis mode and update related logic in VTS ([68048aa](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/68048aa2d20107f95d7676b08db364d6f254708d))
* retire Steam Link 5001812, 5001968 and 5002244 support ([6d19288](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/6d19288bcc91a223ca6277c98f7428fbde19c528))
* **spacewarp:** implement dormant fast path and carrier generation tracking ([68e9d1a](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/68e9d1adbec53b98f218c354505b93cf27ddd8c3))
* **steamlink:** make OpenXR BOOST experimental ([9b1d581](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/9b1d581f0a934c3ad3314da9ecfc84b3f2a0f4b3))
* **steamlink:** restore support for all five builds ([9a75e32](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/9a75e32297b43c70907703a2c37c7ac0520ca07d))
* update codecs support to version 7 with enhanced stability and crash fixes ([ba5c178](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/ba5c178ff463717208abc33bd1edea67841bb669))
* update codecs support to version 8 with stability improvements and crash fixes ([c9e0efa](https://github.com/AngelDark92/xr-porting-hub/commit/c9e0efa88e7005d37665662bd1c770a09b01c22e))
